inputs.value:
Create a polished 30-second vertical 9:16 social advertisement for the fictional nonalcoholic sparkling botanical beverage GLOWBLOOM YUZU PEAR, aimed at trend-conscious adults in their twenties. The adult woman in Pictures 1 and 2 is the only semantic Subject. Preserve her exact identity, short textured black bob, cobalt cropped jacket, cream ribbed top, tangerine wide-leg trousers, white sneakers, natural proportions, and warm realistic skin. The slim orange GLOWBLOOM can is an ordinary recurring hand prop, not a second Subject: never assign the can <Subject 2> or any separate semantic label. When visible, keep its orange satin aluminum, acid-lime botanical linework, deep-blue vertical GLOWBLOOM wordmark, and YUZU PEAR flavor line as faithfully as the model allows. Do not create another person, another outfit, another package, or alcohol cues.

Campaign idea: BRIGHTEN THE IN-BETWEEN. This is an editorial lifestyle/product spot, not an EDM club video. Do not render campaign headlines, captions, legal copy, or floating typography; only the physical can label may be visible.

Use exactly 8 shots with an intentional hard visual transition at exactly 00:15.000. Shot 1, 0–3s: extreme macro of the cold can on a cobalt plinth, tab opening, citrus mist and condensation, controlled macro push. Shot 2, 3–6.5s: the woman steps in and lifts the can, short lateral track ending on her unobstructed face and the label. Shot 3, 6.5–10.5s: she walks through a cream, ultramarine, and tangerine studio set while the camera tracks beside her with coherent foreground parallax. Shot 4, 10.5–15s: she passes behind a translucent tangerine panel; it fills frame as a practical hard wipe. Shot 5, 15–18.5s: the wipe reveals a sunlit urban rooftop where the same woman continues walking; use a brief controlled semicircular arc. Shot 6, 18.5–22.5s: close product-and-hands moment with condensation and a relaxed sip; no speaking, singing, mouthing, or dancing. Shot 7, 22.5–27s: she places the can on a chrome cafe table; use a slow 45-degree product arc with city reflections and coherent parallax. Shot 8, 27–30s: final blue-hour woman-and-can composition, label toward camera, settling into a stable medium product portrait for later end-card typography.

Use polished editorial product photography, analog-flash texture, real fabric and skin, chrome reflections, a golden-hour-to-blue-hour progression, electric tangerine, acid lime, deep ultramarine, and warm cream. Camera movement may be expressive but physically coherent; no dizzying continuous swirl, chaotic whip chain, or impossible compound path.

Soundtrack is instrumental only at approximately 104 BPM: percussive alt-pop and neo-soul with rubbery bass guitar, crisp hand percussion, bright mallet accents, and subtle glassy synth texture. No lyrics, singing, speech, rap, dialogue, four-on-the-floor EDM beat, festival drop, or nightclub ambience. The woman performs natural commercial actions and never mouths the soundtrack.
